description: This Java source file defines the SuggestImpl class, which implements the Suggest interface. It provides functionality for loading dictionaries, generating word suggestions, corrections, and completions for a keyboard input method. The class manages various suggestion modes, interacts with multiple dictionary sources, and handles sub-word splitting and suggestion prioritization.

classes.name: SubWordSuggestionCallback
classes.description: Handles sub-word splitting and suggestion generation based on word splits, providing suggestions for complex or compound words.

classes.name: AutoTextSuggestionCallback
classes.description: Provides suggestions based on auto-text entries, assigning a fixed frequency to such suggestions.

classes.name: AbbreviationSuggestionCallback
classes.description: Provides abbreviation suggestions with a specific frequency bias.

classes.name: DictionarySuggestionCallback
classes.description: Wraps a basic word callback to adjust suggestion frequencies based on context, such as matching the original typed word.

classes.name: SuggestionCallback
classes.description: Handles the insertion and prioritization of suggestion words, managing the suggestion list and their associated frequencies.

methods.name: compareCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Compares a CharSequence with a character array in a case-insensitive manner.

methods.name: setCorrectionMode
methods.description: Configures suggestion behavior regarding corrections, word splitting, and distance thresholds.

methods.name: isSuggestionsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether suggestion mode is enabled.

methods.name: setupSuggestionsForKeyboard
methods.description: Initializes suggestions for the keyboard with provided dictionary sources.

methods.name: setMaxSuggestions
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of suggestions to generate.

methods.name: haveSufficientCommonality
methods.description: Checks if a word has sufficient length and edit distance similarity to another word.

methods.name: resetNextWordSentence
methods.description: Clears the list of next-word suggestions.

methods.name: getNextSuggestions
methods.description: Retrieves suggestions for the next word based on the previous word.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Generates suggestions for a given WordComposer input, including corrections and completions.

methods.name: getLastValidSuggestionIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the last valid suggestion.

methods.name: isValidWord
methods.description: Checks if a word is valid according to the dictionary.

methods.name: addWordToUserDictionary
methods.description: Adds a new word to the user dictionary.

methods.name: removeWordFromUserDictionary
methods.description: Removes a word from the user dictionary.

methods.name: setTagsSearcher
methods.description: Sets the tags extractor used for tag suggestions.

methods.name: tryToLearnNewWord
methods.description: Attempts to learn a new word with a specified addition type.

methods.name: setIncognitoMode
methods.description: Enables or disables incognito mode, affecting dictionary learning.

methods.name: isIncognitoMode
methods.description: Checks if incognito mode is active.
